headline.en: Flag conclusions when their sources change.
headline.zh: 来源变化时标记依赖结论。

sub.en: Provena records claims, source spans and claim dependencies in a graph, then propagates stale status when tracked content changes.
sub.zh: Provena 在图中记录结论、来源片段与结论依赖，并在被跟踪内容变化时传播 stale 状态。

body.en: Claims link to inspectable source objects.
body.zh: 结论关联可检查来源对象。

body.en: Downstream claims inherit the need for review.
body.zh: 下游结论也会被标为待检查。

body.en: Hash comparison and graph traversal are deterministic.
body.zh: 哈希比较与图遍历具有确定性。

title.en: Run it on a complete example

note.en: Create a temporary one-line source and two dependent claims, edit limit=10 to limit=20, then inspect the propagated status.
note.zh: 创建临时单行来源与两条依赖结论，将 limit=10 改为 limit=20，再检查传播状态。

steps.label: Recorded run
steps.body: A temporary source file changes from limit=10 to limit=20, causing two explicit dependent claims to become stale. No model re-derivation.

body.en: Create a temporary one-line source and two dependent claims, edit limit=10 to limit=20, then inspect the propagated status.
body.zh: 创建临时单行来源与两条依赖结论，将 limit=10 改为 limit=20，再检查传播状态。

steps.code:
git clone https://github.com/SuperMarioYL/provena.git
cd provena
uv venv .venv
uv pip install --python .venv/bin/python -e .
source .venv/bin/activate

limitations.en: The engine flags claims for review; it does not automatically re-derive or correct them.
limitations.zh: 引擎标记待检查结论，不会自动重新推导或纠正。

limitations.en: A recorded dependency is supplied by the caller and does not prove the source actually supports the claim.
limitations.zh: 依赖由调用者提供，不证明来源确实支持结论。

limitations.en: File line spans can shift after edits. Source selection and graph completeness affect the usefulness of invalidation.
limitations.zh: 编辑后文件行片段可能移动；来源选择与图完整性影响失效标记的作用。

body.en: A conclusion can outlive the file fragment that supported it. Explicit dependency edges show which claims need another look when that fragment changes.
body.zh: 结论可能在支撑它的文件片段变化后继续被使用。明确依赖边可以指出哪些结论需要重新检查。

body.en: record_claim registers source spans and edges in ClaimDependencyGraph. CascadeEngine compares current source hashes with recorded hashes, then traverses reverse claim dependencies to mark affected conclusions stale. The optional UI displays that state.
body.zh: record_claim 在 ClaimDependencyGraph 中登记来源片段与边；CascadeEngine 比较当前和记录哈希，再沿反向结论依赖遍历，将受影响结论标为 stale。可选 UI 展示这些状态。

body.en: record_claim registers source spans and edges in ClaimDependencyGraph. CascadeEngine compares current source hashes with recorded hashes, then traverses reverse claim dependencies to mark affected conclusions stale. The optional UI displays that state.
body.zh: record_claim 在 ClaimDependencyGraph 中登记来源片段与边；CascadeEngine 比较当前和记录哈希，再沿反向结论依赖遍历，将受影响结论标为 stale。可选 UI 展示这些状态。

body.en: The following routes are implemented in the source. Choose the input that matches your task and keep the resulting artifact with your project.
body.zh: 以下路径已有源码实现。按任务选择输入，并把生成的结果与项目一起保存。

body.en: Use FileSpan.from_file(path, start, end) to capture a source span. record_claim accepts grounded_on source objects or registered IDs and depends_on claim IDs. Integrations should own graph persistence and re-derivation after receiving stale flags.
body.zh: 使用 FileSpan.from_file(path, start, end) 捕获来源片段。record_claim 接受 grounded_on 来源对象或已登记 ID，以及 depends_on 结论 ID。集成方应负责图持久化及收到 stale 后的重新推导。

body.en: The CLI exposes the following operations. Commands after the example use your own paths or identifiers.
body.zh: CLI 提供以下操作。示例之外的命令需要替换成你的文件路径或标识。

details.code:
provena graph --json
provena check
# Interactive local demo server:
provena demo
